name: Hajimete wa Onii-chan 2 ~Yua-chan to Sonogo~
original_name: はじめては おにいちゃん 2 ～ ユアちゃんと その後 ～
source:
This is an after story of the protagonist and Yua, one of friends of his little sister. 
As opposed to the little sister, Yua is even-tempered and well-mannered girl. 

When he has got to take a role of Yua's big brother for some reason, they start getting close.
